title.en: Infrastructure Protection (Saving and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Infrastructure Protection (Saving and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2019 and come into operation on 1 October 2019.
3. Every Section 4 Direction in respect of a deemed protected area continues to apply in respect of the deemed protected area as if it were a direction made under section 21(1) of the Act.
4. Every Section 5 Direction in respect of a deemed protected place continues to apply in respect of the deemed protected place as if it were a direction made under section 21(1) of the Act.
